finalText:
**Migration done in 12 files.** All 36 `db.query` calls now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`. `node --check` passes on every file under `packages`.

I left `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` alone. Its header says do not edit, since upgrades overwrite it. Two `db.query` calls live there.

`cache.query` is a different API. I did not touch it.

Next: keep the `db.query` shim in [lib/db.js:13](lib/db.js:13) until the vendor drop ships a fix.
